title: tpkg lazy seed descriptor v1
description: The LAZY_SEEDING seed descriptor (`<image>.lazy.json`, spec 39 §4): present in a runtime store entry if and only if the entry is mid-seeding. Written tmp+rename under the entry's flock by the loader INSTEAD of the image download; its rename is the lazy install's commit point. Machine-written by the resolve-install path, machine-read by the driver's mount open. Unknown keys are tolerated at every level for forward compatibility; schema_version pins the version.

source.description: The concrete origin URL the groups fetch from (https, or file/loopback-http per spec 39 §6's carve-outs). Recorded verbatim; the origin marker keeps the resolution-level form.

sha256.description: The whole-image sha256 pin — the seal pass re-verifies against exactly this value.

blksum_sha256.description: The digest of the `.blksum.json` sidecar this seed was opened against — verified before the first range read (spec 39 §3).

group_count.description: ceil(size_bytes / group_size); the block directory's completeness bound — `*.blk` files named by zero-padded index below this count.
